firm_data.firm_name: Allen Matkins Leck Gamble Mallory & Natsis LLP
firm_data.firm_description: Allen Matkins has worked with clients for more than 45 years, offering legal solutions with the global reach of a large firm, combined with the lean efficiency of a smaller team. The firm has deep roots in real estate, and has grown to include prominent litigation, corporate, tax, labor and employment, land use, and environmental practices.
